facts: A Quest with Firewood supplies the party with the Resting Point amount printed in the top-left of that Quest card.
The party may Rest only in a cleared Room and only with whole-party agreement.
The party collectively chooses how to distribute the Quest card's Resting Point amount among party members.
Each point spent recovers either 1 Life or 1 Stress.
If distribution cannot be agreed, the amount may be divided equally and each Hero chooses how to spend that Hero's points.
After the Rest is completed, discard the Firewood token from the Provisions Pool.
